3639f114972b4f667bec76930500ac4eda2cfecf: Crévoux is a small, low-key resort — 22 km of runs for an intimate skiing experience, far from the bustle of the big resorts. This is where you come for calm, authenticity and no queues at the lifts. Crévoux's family reputation is well earned: dedicated beginner areas, well-groomed green runs and a friendly atmosphere at the foot of the lifts. It is one of the most reassuring resorts in the Southern Alps for laying the foundations of skiing with children. Crévoux's altitude (1,600 m at the base, 2,100 m at the top) helps it keep a decent snow cover in the depths of winter. January and February are the most reliable months; in December and March, it is worth checking conditions before finalising a booking. The €29 day lift pass remains reasonable for the quality of the ski area on offer. Counting accommodation, skiing and meals, Crévoux suits those who want to spend a good week without the final bill knocking them off their chair. In short: Crévoux is one of those rare resorts that combines a real village, a sincere family atmosphere and runs suitable for everyone. It's hard to have a bad stay here.
3641365805b463c203fda14dd21fe5bbf761b5ca: The Brixen im Thale ski area, with its 275 km of runs, offers a great choice for all kinds of skiers: large enough that you won't go round in circles for a week, yet compact enough to find your favourite sectors easily. Brixen im Thale's family reputation is well earned: dedicated beginner areas, a well-run childcare service, well-maintained green runs and a friendly atmosphere at the foot of the lifts. It is one of the most reassuring resorts in the Northern Alps for learning to ski with children. Brixen im Thale's moderate altitude, from 794 m at the base to 1869 m at the top, makes it sensitive to climate variations. January and February remain the surest months for optimal snow cover. A stay in Brixen im Thale is clearly on the expensive side: €80 for a day lift pass, plus accommodation and mountain restaurants that are among the priciest in the Alps. It is the price of excellence, but you should be aware of it before you go. In short, Brixen im Thale keeps its promises. A Northern Alps resort that will suit most skiers without disappointing.
